description.en: Evidence-chain and conformance checks for any deliverable: turn a requirements document (competition rules, journal guidelines, acceptance criteria, tender documents) into an executable spec and grade the deliverable against it; trace every number to a provenance ledger; audit files for identity leaks in PDF and OOXML metadata plus archive-manifest consistency. Rule packs cover papers, technical documentation, software hand-overs, datasets and bid responses. Ships an agent skill so other harnesses get the same procedure.
description.zh: 交付物证据链与合规校验：把赛会/期刊/验收/招标要求变成可执行规格并逐条判定（页数、摘要单页、页边距、必备文件、许可与变更记录、数据字段与样本量、隐私字段、压缩包清单等），数字台账溯源，PDF 与 DOCX/XLSX 元数据身份信息排查。规则包覆盖论文、技术文档、软件交付、数据交付与标书，并内置 agent skill，其他 harness 也能直接用同一套流程。
